title: SatCompute constellation definition 0.1
description: Closed-world physical constellation structure. Runtime, network, routing, workload, randomness, and output settings are forbidden.

schema_version.description: Constellation definition schema version; must be 0.1.

constellation_pattern.description: Walker structure used to span right ascension of ascending node.

satellites_per_orbit.description: Positive number of satellites in every orbital plane.

altitude_m.description: Circular-orbit altitude above the reference Earth surface in meters.

inclination_deg.description: Orbital inclination in degrees in the half-open range [0, 180).

phase_diff.description: When true, odd planes receive one half-slot argument-latitude offset.

orbit_epoch_offset_s.description: Non-negative orbit propagation offset at simulation time zero, in seconds.
